None of the 46 MCP failures from job 133771119760 remain, and no failure mentions LoadLibrary. All 8 remaining failures are in tests/unit/test_reclaim_collapse.py ("pass_fds not supported on Windows"), from change 3410 (streamed reclaim collapse), outside this bug; routed separately by the coordinator.

The fifth acceptance criterion requires the "sweep (windows)" job to pass. It concluded failure because of those 8 unrelated tests, so that box stays unticked and the ticket stays open until that job passes or the criterion is changed by the operator.
